title: The Crooked Hollow
premise: Yara Dravenmoor, last of the oath-bound swordspeakers, has spent her life guiding smugglers through the Thornfell mountains while burying the grief of a broken covenant that silenced the old gods. When prayers begin to be answered again, she discovers her dead mother's blade is the key: it can reforge the covenant between realms, but only if Yara surrenders the name and life she built for herself. Hunted by the usurper Vaelric's armies and torn between duty to the realms and love for the smuggler captain Sef Marrow, she climbs to the Hollow Shrine where the covenant was first sworn. There she reforges the bond at terrible cost — the gods return, the free cities hold, and Yara becomes something new: neither woman nor sword, but the living oath itself.
about_author: I. M. Ravensworth is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping mountain passes before turning to fantasy. They write stories about borders — of land, of self, and of what we owe the dead.

chapters.title: The Answered Prayer
chapters.summary: Yara guides a smuggler caravan through Thornfell when a dying stranger's desperate prayer is suddenly answered by an impossible light in the mountains. Her mother's heirloom blade begins to hum with a voice she hasn't heard since childhood. Told from Yara's POV; the emotional beat is reluctant wonder cracking open old grief.

chapters.title: What the Blade Remembers
chapters.summary: Fleeing Vaelric's scouts, Yara shelters with Sef Marrow's smuggler crew and learns the blade carries her mother's final oath — and the truth of how the covenant broke. The usurper's priests offer Yara pardon if she surrenders the sword. Told from Yara's POV; the beat is identity shaken as she realizes she never chose her inheritance.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Road
chapters.summary: Vaelric's army closes on the free cities, and Yara must choose: flee with Sef, whom she has come to love, or climb to the Hollow Shrine alone. Sef defies her and follows, forcing both to weigh love against duty on the killing slopes. Told alternately from Yara's and Sef's POV; the beat is sacrifice declared and refused.

chapters.title: The Living Oath
chapters.summary: At the Hollow Shrine, Yara faces the god-echo of her mother and learns the covenant demands a speaker who gives up their own name forever. With Sef holding the line below against Vaelric's vanguard, Yara speaks the reforging words and dissolves into the new covenant. Told from Yara's POV; the beat is transcendence through surrender — the gods return, the cities stand, and Sef carries her memory home.
